svg.title: Round-1 website test-run PnL across eight archived submissions
svg.desc: Stacked columns of IMC website test-run PnL in XIRECs for the eight archived Round-1 submissions, split into the ASH market maker (blue) and the PEPPER trend-carry engine (orange), with each run's maximum drawdown in a lower panel. All eight ran on the same 1,000-tick test sample. Total PnL rose from 1,817 to 4,789 (about 2.6 times) while the maximum drawdown shrank from 254 to 56 XIRECs. Values: 1 baseline: 1,817.16 (ASH 944.25, PEPPER 872.91), max drawdown −254.04; 2 trend in fair value: 2,317.28 (ASH 1,076.97, PEPPER 1,240.31), max drawdown −57.19; 3 split engines: 4,368.94 (ASH 1,443.44, PEPPER 2,925.50), max drawdown −52.31; 4 balanced inventory: 3,102.00 (ASH 1,496.38, PEPPER 1,605.62), max drawdown −52.83; 5 long floor: 3,685.66 (ASH 1,443.44, PEPPER 2,242.22), max drawdown −57.94; 6 same code as 5: 3,685.66 (ASH 1,443.44, PEPPER 2,242.22), max drawdown −57.94; 7 max-long carry: 4,738.81 (ASH 1,484.81, PEPPER 3,254.00), max drawdown −55.31; 8 regime machine: 4,789.06 (ASH 1,484.81, PEPPER 3,304.25), max drawdown −56.19.
